question: Which of the following states has an underground bunker museum in the official residence of its Governor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jal Bhushan,** the office and residence of the **Governor of Maharashtra** has a history of about 200 years.
 
• **Dioramas of cannons and soldiers**, optical illusions of a bunker of infinite length and cannons have also been **generated inside the museum**.
 
• The present building has undergone many **modifications and renovations**.
 
• Inside** Mumbai's Raj Bhavan Bunker Museum**: Underground shelter to offer visitors a glimpse into Indian history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Gandhi Memorial Museum** started in **1959**, is a memorial museum for Mahatma Gandhi situated in the city of Madurai in **Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• The** Karnataka State** Tribal Research Institute is fitting to set up the state's first tribal museum in Mysuru.
 
• **Maharaja Fateh Singh** Museum is the largest museum in** Gujrat.**
